recognize_zh: 臨床照片顯示雙上臂廣泛融合的紅色斑丘疹（麻疹樣藥疹），胸腹部顏色較深但未見水疱或表皮剝落；配合使用 dapsone 的病史，才能推想為藥物反應伴嗜酸性白血球增多與全身症狀（DRESS），照片本身無法確立診斷。
features: Diffuse erythematous macular-papular (morbilliform) eruption on both upper limbs, coalescing into patches
Background of dusky erythema over the trunk
No visible bullae, target lesions, skin necrosis or epidermal detachment
Mucous membranes and face not shown, limiting assessment of SJS/TEN or facial edema
describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a widespread erythematous morbilliform eruption involving both arms, with coalescent macules and papules, and diffuse erythema of the trunk. No blisters, epidermal detachment or target lesions are visible, and the face and mucosa are not shown. The image alone is non-specific; in a patient receiving dapsone, it is compatible with drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS), which requires correlation with latency (2–8 weeks), fever, lymphadenopathy, eosinophilia or atypical lymphocytosis and organ involvement (RegiSCAR criteria).

ddx.vs: Uncomplicated exanthems lack fever, facial edema, eosinophilia, atypical lymphocytes and liver or kidney involvement.
SJS/TEN shows dusky targetoid lesions, blistering with Nikolsky sign and mucosal erosions, not seen here.
Viral rashes occur without new drug exposure, and serology/PCR helps, although HHV-6 reactivation also occurs in DRESS.
These cause cyanosis, bite cells and Heinz bodies rather than rash, and may coexist with DRESS.
